report.explanation: Current evidence contradicts the operator hypothesis: gateway checkout traces are OK (1 success, 0 errors), order logs show status 200/ok, and order metrics show low error rate (0.0014), p95 70ms, zero dependency timeouts and zero db pool waiters. The deployment record proves only version facts (3.3.9 from 3.3.8, 1583 min old) and cannot establish deployment-caused failures. No current evidence substantiates any taxonomy cause, so hand off for missing failure evidence.
missing_evidence: Checkout failure evidence: error traces/spans or 5xx responses for checkout, since gateway checkout span is OK with 0 errors
Order service error evidence: logs show request_result ok and status 200; metrics error_rate 0.0014, no timeouts
Deployment-causation evidence: deploy record only shows version 3.3.9 from 3.3.8 at 1583 min age; no causal link to failures
Baseline comparison of order latency/error rate before and after deployment to test the operator hypothesis
